name: Section
summary: A section of a page with space around it and a head, the page's column, and a wrapping row of actions.

guidance.useFor: Dividing a page into named parts (selected work, journal, services), each with a heading and perhaps a link to see everything; the page's column (Wrap); a row of buttons or links (Actions).
insteadUse: A panel that stands out from the page: Card
Arranging items inside a section: Layout's Grid or Cluster
content: Name each section with a heading
The head's action says where it goes: "All projects", not "More"

rungReason: <section> named by its heading is a region landmark; the rest is CSS on native elements.

attributes.aria-labelledby: the heading's id, when it has one

keyboard.action: Reaches the head's action, then the section's content

props.title: the heading; it names the section

rules: A section without a heading is a plain section (no landmark); give it one when people will want to jump to it
Reflow at 320 px: the head wraps, the action goes under the heading
